description_en: Subscribes to multi-level bills for Alibaba Cloud ecosystem partners and generates the bills in OSS
description_zh: 阿里云生态伙伴多级账单订阅oss生成
kebab_example: aliyun agency subscription-bill --subscribe-bucket bill-bucket --bucket-owner-id 5569414254138836 --subscribe-type PartnerBillingItemDetailForBillingPeriod --begin-billing-cycle 2022-10 --bill-format csv --api-version 2022-12-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubscriptionBill

parameters.help_en: The name of the OSS bucket that stores the bills
parameters.name: subscribe_bucket

parameters.help_en:
The UID of the account to which the OSS bucket for storing the files belongs.

If the subscription is made by a partner and the files need to be pushed to the OSS bucket of a subordinate partner account, this account must be the subordinate partner account of the partner account, and the AliyunConsumeDump2OSSRole (https://ram.console.aliyun.com/?spm=api-workbench.API%20Document.0.0.68c71e0fhmTSJp#/role/authorize?request=%7B%22Requests%22:%20%7B%22request1%22:%20%7B%22RoleName%22:%20%22AliyunConsumeDump2OSSRole%22,%20%22TemplateId%22:%20%22Dump2OSSRole%22%7D%7D,%20%22ReturnUrl%22:%20%22https:%2F%2Fusercenter2.aliyun.com%22,%20%22Service%22:%20%22Consume%22%7D) permission must be granted to the subordinate partner account. 

If the subscription is made by a partner and the files are pushed to the OSS bucket of the partner account, the AliyunConsumeDump2OSSRole (https://ram.console.aliyun.com/?spm=api-workbench.API%20Document.0.0.68c71e0fhmTSJp#/role/authorize?request=%7B%22Requests%22:%20%7B%22request1%22:%20%7B%22RoleName%22:%20%22AliyunConsumeDump2OSSRole%22,%20%22TemplateId%22:%20%22Dump2OSSRole%22%7D%7D,%20%22ReturnUrl%22:%20%22https:%2F%2Fusercenter2.aliyun.com%22,%20%22Service%22:%20%22Consume%22%7D) permission must be granted to the partner account
parameters.help_zh:
存储文件Oss归属的UID。

如果是伙伴订阅，并需要推送到下级伙伴账号的OSS上时，需要此账号为伙伴账号的下级伙伴账号，并对下级伙伴账号授予AliyunConsumeDump2OSSRole (https://ram.console.aliyun.com/?spm=api-workbench.API%20Document.0.0.68c71e0fhmTSJp#/role/authorize?request=%7B%22Requests%22:%20%7B%22request1%22:%20%7B%22RoleName%22:%20%22AliyunConsumeDump2OSSRole%22,%20%22TemplateId%22:%20%22Dump2OSSRole%22%7D%7D,%20%22ReturnUrl%22:%20%22https:%2F%2Fusercenter2.aliyun.com%22,%20%22Service%22:%20%22Consume%22%7D)权限 

如果是伙伴订阅,且推送到伙伴账号的OSS时,需要伙伴账号进行授予AliyunConsumeDump2OSSRole (https://ram.console.aliyun.com/?spm=api-workbench.API%20Document.0.0.68c71e0fhmTSJp#/role/authorize?request=%7B%22Requests%22:%20%7B%22request1%22:%20%7B%22RoleName%22:%20%22AliyunConsumeDump2OSSRole%22,%20%22TemplateId%22:%20%22Dump2OSSRole%22%7D%7D,%20%22ReturnUrl%22:%20%22https:%2F%2Fusercenter2.aliyun.com%22,%20%22Service%22:%20%22Consume%22%7D)权限
parameters.name: bucket_owner_id

parameters.help_en:
The subscription type. Valid values: 
EndUserInstanceDaily: customer instance daily bill.
EndUserlnstanceMonthly: customer instance monthly bill.
PartnerInstanceDaily: partner instance daily bill.
PartnerInstanceMonthly: partner instance monthly bill
parameters.help_zh:
订阅类型 
EndUserInstanceDaily  客户实例日账单
EndUserlnstanceMonthly    客户实例月账单
PartnerInstanceDaily  伙伴实例日账单
PartnerInstanceMonthly 伙伴实例月账单
parameters.name: subscribe_type

parameters.help_en:
The starting month for pushing bills.
Format: yyyy-MM.

After the subscription succeeds, the system automatically pushes the data from the starting billing cycle to the current time. A maximum of six months of recent data (including the current month) can be pushed. If the period exceeds six months, the subscription is invalid
parameters.help_zh:
起始推送账单月份
格式yyyy-MM

订阅成功后，系统会自动推送起始账期到当前时间的数据。最多可推送最近六个月内数据(包含当前月)。超出则订阅无效
parameters.name: begin_billing_cycle

parameters.help_en:
The format of the bill file. Valid values:
csv
parquet

If you subscribe to multiple file types, use different buckets for the subscriptions to prevent files from being overwritten
parameters.help_zh:
账单文件格式
可选
csv
parquet

如果订阅多个文件类型,建议区分bucket订阅.避免文件覆盖
parameters.name: bill_format

parameters.help_en:
The threshold for the number of bill data rows in a single file. If the number of rows exceeds this threshold, the data is automatically split into multiple files. The naming convention for the split files is `uid_billType_billCycle_SquenceNo_fileNo`.

If the file names are identical except for the fileNo parameter, the files are considered to be of the same billing cycle and the same type, and are multiple files generated due to splitting
parameters.help_zh:
单个文件账单数据行数阈值，超过此阈值会自动拆分成多个文件，拆分后文件的命名规则为`uid_billType_billCycle_SquenceNo_fileNo`

文件名称除fileNo信息不一致外其他信息全部一致,可视为同一账期,同一类型文件.因拆分导致的多个文件
parameters.name: subscribe_segment_size

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
Success.name: Success
